answers.question: How long does an SMP treatment take?
answers.text: SMP is done in 2 to 4 sessions, spaced 7–14 days apart. Each session lasts about 2–3 hours.

answers.question: Does SMP hurt?
answers.text: The treatment is mildly uncomfortable, but most clients describe it as a scratching sensation. Local anesthesia is not used except in special cases (at the client's request).

answers.question: How long does the SMP effect last?
answers.text: The effect lasts 2 to 4 years, after which a pigment refresh session is recommended.

answers.question: Is SMP the same as a tattoo?
answers.text: No. SMP uses special pigments, finer needles, and shallower punctures. It does not blur or change color like regular tattoos.

answers.question: What does the result look like for bald men?
answers.text: The effect resembles a close-shaved head. The pigment imitates hair follicles and follows the natural shape of the head.

answers.question: Is there a visible difference between pigment and real hair?
answers.text: If the treatment is done professionally – no. The pigment tone is chosen according to your hair and skin color.

answers.question: Do I have to shave my head if I only have thinning hair?
answers.text: No. This treatment maintains your natural hair length, and pigment is used to fill in light gaps.

answers.question: Can I combine SMP with a hair transplant?
answers.text: Yes. SMP is often done after a transplant to increase density and fill in gaps.

answers.question: Can pigment be applied over scars?
answers.text: Yes – SMP effectively covers scars from transplantation (FUE/FUT), as well as those from injuries or surgeries.

answers.question: Is SMP safe on scar tissue?
answers.text: Yes, but the treatment is done carefully and in layers – after analyzing the skin condition.

tretmanFlow.description: Note: Throughout the entire process, a fine needle and special pigment designed for the scalp are used. The client can resume daily activities the day after the treatment.

– usually performed 10–20 days after the first. This interval allows the pigment from the first session to stabilize in the skin. During this session, density is increased, transitions and details are defined to create an even more natural look.

– the final treatment where, after the previous two sessions have set their appearance, the frontal hairline and any imperfections noticed during earlier treatments can be refined. If further adjustments are needed, an additional treatment may be offered at no extra charge.
